description: Set the one thing this site's visitors should do (book a call, start checkout, sign up). Findings then rank by what they cost it, and fixes are judged by it. Find candidates in the code first (Stripe/checkout links, signup forms, CTA button text) and confirm with the user. Free. The reply carries goal_check {status, matches, suggestions}: the goal is checked at once against real clicks from the last 14 days, else the live page. If status is no_match, the goal will count 0 conversions: do not leave it; pick the right text from suggestions (or the code) and call set_goal again in the same session. If unverified (no click data yet, page may be drawn by JavaScript), confirm the exact button text in the code.

kind.description: click = a click whose text or selector contains match; page = visiting a path (exact, or a prefix ending in *)

matches.description: Button texts exactly as rendered (e.g. ['Book a call', 'BOOK A CALL']) or paths (e.g. ['/thank-you', '/c/*'])

value_usd.description: What one conversion is worth, if the user knows; enables dollar figures

name: set_goal
